    The nonzero morphisms form a basis of the linearization #

    For a finite ray category P, the classes in k(P) of the nonzero morphisms (a vertex idempotent for an identity, the class of any path with the given value otherwise) form a basis (RayQuiver.linBasis; Gabriel–Roiter 13.5). They span because the span is stable under multiplication by vertices and arrows, and they are independent because the regular representation sends them to the standard basis.
